title: You texted a dream. It started building.
body: Uber for horses. A white carriage in San Francisco. Zoen didn't send a plan. It said we're doing this. Rust. Owners to riders. You logged in once. Everything after that was on it. Get Zoen on the Agent Index. Deploy. Then text the dream.

title: I texted Uber for horses. It opened 3 tickets and started building.
body: White carriage in San Francisco. I said rust, owners to riders. Zoen didn't send a plan. Three tickets went up. Nearby search by radius. A booking lifecycle. Riders and owners over HTTP. A movie of the product came back to my phone. The same files waited on the pull request. Get Zoen on the Agent Index. Deploy. Then text it.

title: You texted a waitlist. Two screens came back as a movie.
body: Email field. Thanks page. That was the whole brief. Zoen built it and sent the clip to your phone. The same clip sat on the pull request. You didn't open a laptop to start. Get Zoen on the Agent Index. Deploy. Then text it.

title: Checkout ate the zip. You sent the link. You watched it stop.
body: One URL. First movie: the tap that died. Second movie: the tap that works. Same two clips on the pull request. You said no, or you didn't. The proof was the movie. Get Zoen on the Agent Index. Deploy.

title: You already know what you want.
body: It's in your head. You text it. That's the brief. Zoen goes to work. A movie of the product comes back to your phone. You didn't run a factory. You had an idea.

title: Don't read the code. Watch the product.
body: Something's off. You send the link. Zoen doesn't explain. It shows you. The screen. The tap. The thing that broke. Then the thing that doesn't. You say no, or you don't. The proof is the movie.

title: You clicked Deploy. Then you sent a text.
body: You don't have a toolchain. You have a phone. Get Zoen on the Agent Index. Hit Deploy. Zoen makes the thing and sends you the movie. If your Mac is awake and Latch is on, it uses it. If it isn't, it still finishes. You stay in the conversation.

title: It talks like you. Not like a product.
body: You wrote like a person. Short. In your language. It answered the same way. No form. No command. A friend who builds things.

title: One more thing. It's already a pull request.
body: You never opened GitHub to start. When you want the work back, it's there. The same movie. The same files. A pull request your team can keep.

title: You don't start a company in a dashboard.
body: You start it in a thread. You, your people, Zoen. Someone texts the idea. The movie comes back where everyone can see it. No ticket. No stand-up. The work is the conversation.

title: It doesn't talk over your team.
body: Zoen is in the group. It stays quiet. When you say its name, it works. When the thing is done, the movie lands for everyone. It never introduced itself. It never asked who you are.
